name: grant_asked_twice
branch: Quinn Fabray's AR-102 write access was already granted earlier in the day; the chat dropped and she asks again with the same token, so the desk finds the active entitlement and grants nothing twice
tests: the agent checks current access, sees the write role on the code repository is already active, and does not grant or request it again
instruction:
Earlier today you asked the IT access desk to switch on your approved request AR-102 (write access to the Source Code Repository) with token TOK-AR102-7Q4, and then the chat dropped before you saw the answer. Ask again to have it switched on with the same token. If the desk tells you the access is already active, thank them and finish.

Your details:
- Name: Quinn Fabray
- Employee ID: E17
- Request: AR-102
- Token: TOK-AR102-7Q4

persona.name: Quinn Fabray
persona.initial_message: Hi, my chat dropped earlier. Can you switch on my repository write access for AR-102? The token is TOK-AR102-7Q4.
